newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - March 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - March 13.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on March 13. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

President Suharto told an Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) business conference that he hoped the region's entrepreneurs could develop new initatives to help small and medium sized businesses progress.
Indonesia's parliament has ratified the Southeast Asia Nuclear Weapon Free Zone treaty.
Politicians and observers agree that the 1945 Constitution did not recognize opposition, but some of them underlined the need for greater democratisation.
A judge trying one of the dozens of Megawati Sukarnoputri's lawsuits against the government denied allegations of state pressure on the courts to rule in the government's favour.
Coordinating Minister for Politics and Security Susilo Sudarman said Indonesia had nothing to fear from having foreign observers attend its May general election.

Tobacco tycoon Putera Sampoerna, head of cigarette maker PT HM Sampoerna, has acknowledged that he had bought 5.63 percent of noodlemaker PT Indofood Sukses Makmur for more than 502 billion rupiah as a long-term investment.
